verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing exposes automation-like logic: spending controls and real-time authorization webhooks. Versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those rules is a fair question for this kind of platform. Nothing in the evidence shows a documented way to version, review, or roll back automations; test-mode simulation is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
